# test: paint orth-adjacent cells of a 1/6 with 7, diagonals of a 2 with 4; also check demo1&2&3&4 under that rule
def f(Ib):
    I=np.array(Ib); H,W=I.shape; O=I.copy()

        for c in range(W):

            orth=[int(I[a,b]) for dr,dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)] for a,b in [(r+dr,c+dc)] if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W]
            diag=[int(I[a,b]) for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)] for a,b in [(r+dr,c+dc)] if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W]
